# Anna Taylor on Becker’s Healthcare Podcast: How MultiCare Uses Tuva for Population Health


In this episode, MultiCare AVP Anna Taylor explains how Tuva supports population health analytics transformation across a large value-based care environment.


Anna Taylor, Associate Vice President of Population Health and Value-based Care at MultiCare, joined Becker's Healthcare Podcast to discuss MultiCare's population health analytics work.


The conversation covers why transparency, control, and scalable healthcare data infrastructure matter for teams working across claims, clinical, and value-based care data.


[Listen to Episode](https://www.beckershospitalreview.com/podcasts/podcasts-beckers-hospital-review/anna-taylor-associate-vice-president-of-population-health-and-value-based-care-at-multicare-connected-care-142347624/)
